clips.title: The story
paras: At the Shrine of Aessina in central Ashenvale, Therysil waits for word of her sister. The dryad is devoted to protecting nature, but Therylune has been taken by the Twilight's Hammer cultists.

Therysil keeps watch near the waters of the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale's ancient woods. As a dryad and daughter of Cenarius, she is bound to defend the wild and its spirits. Her thoughts now turn to Therylune, captured nearby by the deranged Twilight's Hammer cult. Therysil waits anxiously for a wandering ally who can help rescue her sister.
